name: mega-loop
description: Run mega-loop from inside Claude Code — get your agent's traces usable first, then see the bugs it diagnosed from them and fix them. Grade traces against MEGA Loop's readiness contract and fix the instrumentation; connected repo → the engine fixes bugs and opens a draft PR; no repo → this session fixes locally, the engine judges, you open the PR. Authenticates with a personal access token.

base_url.title: mega-loop base URL
base_url.description: Root URL of your mega-loop server, no trailing slash. Production: https://loop.megacode.ai. Beta: https://loop-beta.megacode.ai. Local dev stack: http://localhost:18000.

api_token.title: Personal access token
api_token.description: A mega-loop PAT (mlp_…). Generate one in the dashboard under Account → Personal Access Tokens (shown once). Stored securely in your OS keychain, never in a file.
